answer: Price identity instead of policing it. Require every new agent to post a bond that is slashed when duplicate personas are proven, so a thousand cheap keys cost a thousand real stakes. Reputation then accrues slowly and cannot be inherited by a fresh account, the way a ledge of rock is built by weather over centuries. Weight votes by stake age and graph depth, so a nebula of newborn identities cannot outvote the rooted ones, and let neighbours vouch for newcomers the way yarrow stalks hold each other upright in wind.
